notes: DRAFT for C-STORY-f. Jay decided (t531u): the town starts as the approved A4 town-square concept (incoming-art/town-square-concept, A4-4/A4-5: main dojo, shop, placeholder, Student of the Month statue, river with bridge and koi, practice yard, lamp posts, Tower with one light). After each real belt test, one visible change makes it livelier and more homely. Night stays the cozy version. Each change is per-player state keyed to that player's own belt; the phone draws the town from the player's own progress, and other players simply appear in it. No change is shown on or about other players, nothing marks anyone's belt, and nothing hints that something is missing. Black is out of scope (placeholder only). Text only; code and art are needed to show it.
base: incoming-art/town-square-concept (A4, day approved by Jay; dusk = cozy night)

rules.stateKey: player's own highest earned belt; changes are cumulative
rules.sharedSquare: each phone renders its own town; other players are drawn on top and never change it
rules.noShame: no empty plots, signs, locks or 'coming soon' marks; a lower-belt town must look complete on its own
rules.night: cozy dusk version; every light has a source; no new scary darkness

changes.whatChanges: The two lamp posts in the square light up for the first time with a soft gold glow, and a small new lamp appears on the bridge.
changes.where: Town square: the two lamp posts by the statue, and the arched bridge.
changes.dayNote: The lamp glass sparkles in the sun. One little gold spark floats up toward the Tower.
changes.nightNote: The new lamps add warm pools of light on the paving and bridge. Fireflies gather near them.
changes.rewardMessage: You brought light home! The town lamps are glowing.
changes.storyTieIn: Lamp Keeper / Lantern Halls: the first piece of light comes home, and the first lamps shine.

changes.dayNote: Bees and butterflies drift over the flowers. Petals move in the breeze.
changes.nightNote: The flowers close up sleepy. Two fireflies rest on the dojo vine.
changes.rewardMessage: The garden woke up! Flowers are blooming everywhere.
changes.storyTieIn: Sun Gardener / Sunrise Garden: the thorns are gone, so flowers open again.

changes.dayNote: A soft curl of smoke rises. The bread basket is full and the table is set for many.
changes.nightNote: Warm orange glow from the oven window. A lantern hangs over the long table.
changes.rewardMessage: Supper smells so good! The town has a table for everyone.
changes.storyTieIn: Hearth Cook / Ember Kitchens: the town eats together at one long table again.

changes.rewardMessage: Step by step! A new path is ready to explore.
changes.storyTieIn: Stone Giant / Giant's Steps: worries feel smaller when we name them; big things are climbed one step at a time.
